notes: Frozen-zone data (plan section 4). The loop reads this file and never writes it; a bar is added or changed only through the D3 protocol.
Every bar is an executable check named by `check`, resolved in harness/completion_spec.py; an unknown check refuses the whole spec.
Bar results are always reported passed-against-full-total. A run that cannot exercise a class is a PARTIAL diagnostic and earns zero exit credit (D5).
Where a bar measures a decision mechanism it names the mechanism's canonical register home and restates none of its rules.

bars.evidence_surface: GitHub issue API + docs/jev-roadmap.md register (issue rows and non-issue rows)
bars.description: Zero open obligations on the plan-of-record inventory, excluding rows in explicit operator hold (named and counted, never worked).

bars.evidence_surface: two-method census: GitHub issue API against the roadmap register
bars.description: The API issue count and the register's issue rows reconcile with receipted closures; no unexplained difference in either direction.

bars.evidence_surface: docs/jev-roadmap.md non-issue rows (U-C4, Slice 2, Wave 5 items, SELF-IMPROVE)
bars.description: Non-issue obligations live on the register as rows and are counted; a zero-issue census alone is a census defect.

bars.evidence_surface: closure records on the issues/PRs and their #295 receipts
bars.description: Every closure in the census carries one of the four evidence classes; an unclassified closure is an open obligation.

bars.evidence_surface: docs/jev-roadmap.md register and its #295 census view
bars.description: The P5 plan-of-record section 16.5 register checks are recorded and every one passes.

bars.evidence_surface: GitHub pull API, drafts included
